verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents "Freedom to self-host your data" and lets users store the Pass vault in their own cloud or as an encrypted file on an external drive. The code is published on GitHub, and the product is local-first, so it runs on the user's own device rather than a vendor service. However, there is no documented guide to deploying or self-hosting any 2FAS server component, such as sync or the browser-extension backend. missing for 10: documented self-hosted deployment of server-side components (sync/extension relay), self-hosting instructions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You decide where to store your Items. You can store it in your own cloud or keep it as an encrypted file on an external drive.
You can easily take a look at our code - reflecting our transparent and user-first approach. Check out our GitHub repository
